ploidyspec report: laPotPerf1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 26 chromosome numbers; the numbers form sets of 2 (13 groups of mostly 2 chromosome numbers), so x ≈ 13 and up to 4x relative to x.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number); 13 groups of mostly 2 chromosome numbers (genome partition z = 19.3); homeolog distance 0.088 vs unrelated 0.120

Auto-like or allo-like?

Allo-like (disomic-like): the duplicated sets do not interchange, from homeolog pairs (pair-depth CV 0.08). This is also what a long-rediploidized autopolyploid looks like.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 26 chromosome numbers assessed: 26 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.3552

Rediploidization

Advanced: no stretch where homeologs are as close as alleles, and the karyotype has been rearranged since the duplication. Also: 3 chromosome(s) carry blocks homeologous to two or more others (chr03:chr13+chr15+chr20, chr11:chr16+chr25, chr20:chr03+chr10): fusions, fissions or translocations since the duplication; homeologous-exchange candidates on 2 chromosome(s), stretches closer to the homeolog than to the own homolog (exchange, or a contig placed on the wrong chromosome).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 0/26 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers; pair-depth CV 0.08; homeology map: 36% of the genome in 35 homeolog blocks, 14 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.04; exchange: chr09(chr24:1/2);chr17(chr07:1/2)

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
